description: This file defines a CanvasDigitalGauge class for rendering customizable digital gauges on HTML Canvas, including drawing methods, configuration, and visual effects, used within a widget library in a larger project.

classes.name: Drawings
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for font styling, value normalization, and error verification.

classes.name: CanvasDigitalGauge
classes.description: Main class extending BaseGauge to render a customizable digital gauge with various visual styles and effects.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures gauge options, normalizing values and setting angles based on gauge type.

methods.name: normalizeValue
methods.description: Normalizes a value within min and max bounds to a 0-1 range.

methods.name: initValueClone
methods.description: Initializes off-screen canvas clones for smooth rendering.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up canvas clones and resources.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs the drawing of the gauge, including background, title, value, and progress arc.

methods.name: getValueColor
methods.description: Returns the current color used for the gauge's value arc.
